# acli-py dashboard

Find dashboards.


## `acli-py dashboard list`

Search dashboards.

```text
acli-py dashboard list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--name` `TEXT` |  | Name contains. |
| `--owner` `TEXT` |  | Owner: email, name or @me. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py dashboard view`

Show a dashboard.

```text
acli-py dashboard view DASHBOARD_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DASHBOARD_ID` | required | Dashboard id. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
